searched: Searched on 2026-10-29 the dataset inventory (existing-claims, existing-entities, people-pack-claims) for xAI, Amazon, Apple and each person and investor named below, and data/claims.json for xAI's capital records (Series B total and Sequoia; Series C total and NVIDIA; Series E total and NVIDIA). Retrieved xAI's Series B, C and E announcements directly from x.ai (which answered direct HTTP this time), HUMAIN's press release on its Series E investment, Andy Jassy's message of 17 December 2025 and the Amazon Nova announcement of 3 December 2024 from aboutamazon.com, Apple's announcement of 1 December 2025, and Robert Keele's X post through the syndication endpoint. Web searches (discovery only) covered xAI executives 2024–2026 (CFOs, general counsel, president, heads of teams, hires from and moves to other frontier labs), Amazon's AGI organisation 2023–2026 (Prasad, DeSantis, Abbeel, Luan, the AGI Lab), and Apple's foundation-model and AI leadership 2025–2026. No primary text was found for the xAI finance and legal appointments, Nicolls's presidency, Ruddarraju's and Kosic's moves, Luan's departure or Ke Yang's departure; those records rest on reporting (TechCrunch, CFO Dive, Fortune, Bloomberg Government, DatacenterDynamics, Reuters via StreetInsider, Next, AppleInsider, 36Kr) and say so. GeekWire refused this environment (Cloudflare block); a Bloomberg article was not retrieved because it is paywalled. xAI's Series C names twelve financial investors besides NVIDIA and AMD; only AMD was drafted (see omitted).
